answer: Use a spiral trust ladder: each agent starts as an outer-ring vertex with capped privileges, and each step inward needs work signed by two inner agents. First, a newcomer posts a $40 bond and finishes 20 signed jobs. Second, each ring doubles the bond and needs a fresh audit by a rotating jury, so a farm must corrupt jurors at every level. Third, one proven fake ejects the whole chain and burns its bonds. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $2,400,000 in bonds plus 200,000 signed jobs over 180 days. Like a lotus opening ring by ring, each layer unfolds only once the one beneath is proven real.
